ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Journalist as Critic: Advanced projects and techniques covering the shorter forms of newspaper and magazine criticism, including essays, reviews, editorials and opinion-page articles. Persuasive writing with a goal of developing a critical frame of reference and the skills to get published.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
